title: Shakira Pledges $1.25 Million to Rebuild Colombia Schools After Earthquake
summary: Shakira has committed an initial $1.25 million — with Global Citizen, Live Nation and CAF — to rebuild schools damaged by the earthquake in Colombia's Chocó region.
body: Shakira has committed an initial $1.25 million to help rebuild schools damaged by the earthquake that struck her native Colombia, announcing the pledge during a surprise visit to one of the hardest-hit regions of the country. The Colombian superstar traveled Monday (Aug. 17) to Quibdó, the capital of the province of Chocó, where nearly 200 schools have reported damage following the 7.4-magnitude earthquake that struck western Colombia on Aug. 10, killing hundreds of people. She toured damaged classrooms, meeting students and educators, and met with Chocó’s governor, Nubia Carolina Córdoba, and Quibdó’s mayor, Rafael Bolaños, to hear about the region’s needs. The $1.25 million commitment brings together several partners: $500,000 from Shakira and Live Nation , $500,000 from the FIFA Global Citizen Education Fund, and $250,000 from CAF, the development bank of Latin America and the Caribbean. The funds, channeled through Shakira’s Fundación Pies Descalzos (Barefoot Foundation), will go toward rebuilding schools and getting children back into classrooms. title: Hayden Panettiere’s Music Career, ‘Nashville’ & Beyond: 5 Things to Know
summary: The actress charted country hits & even earned a Grammy nomination.
body: Hayden Panettiere , the actress and singer best known for her roles in Heroes , Scream and Nashville , died Sunday at age 36 . While Panettiere sculpted an enduring acting career beginning as a child, her work in music was an equally memorable part of her legacy — particularly through her role as country star Juliette Barnes on Nashville . As Juliette, Panettiere performed dozens of songs throughout the ABC musical drama’s six-season run, many of which were released commercially through the show’s soundtrack albums. Her performances weren’t simply incidental to the series. Panettiere’s recordings made their way onto Billboard ‘s country charts, giving the actress a legitimate chart history of her own. Her rendition of “Telescope,” for example, became one of the best-known songs associated with her Nashville character, while recordings including “Undermine,” “Wrong Song” and “Don’t Put Dirt on My Grave Just Yet” also charted. title: A Timeline of Cardi B & BIA’s Feud
summary: The rivalry was renewed on Thursday (Aug. 13).
body: After exchanging diss tracks in the past, all seemed to be calm on the BIA and Cardi B front for much of 2026. That all changed last Thursday (Aug. 13) when BIA doubled down on her claims made on “SUE MEEE?,” which led to Cardi unleashing on the “Whole Lotta Money” rapper hours later. The feud stretches back to 2023, when BIA aligned herself with Cardi’s rival, Nicki Minaj, as they teamed up on “Whole Lotta Money” in 2020, and fans noticed BIA allegedly scrubbed her X account of Cardi-praising posts she had made in the past. However, BIA said they had no problems. Still, in 2024, Cardi and BIA threw their names into the rap beef ring. title: The Best Moments From KCON LA 2026
summary: The three-day festival closed with a fourth BTS cover of the weekend as the likes of NEXZ, RESCENE, MEOVV and TOMORROW X TOGETHER connected with K-pop fans at the Crypto.com Arena.
body: Los Angeles officially belonged to K-pop this weekend with KCON LA 2026, but the city was deep in K-pop all week. This year’s KCON festival officially opened Friday (Aug. 14) at the Los Angeles Convention Center and Crypto.com Arena. Under the theme of “K-SOUL CITY,” a play on the South Korean capital, festival producer CJ ENM is stretching 2026’s convention across K-pop, K-beauty, K-food and K-story programming, including the first-ever Olive Young Festa K-Beauty Playground, which boasts 55 different Korean brands. But by the time doors opened on day one, the city had already been running on K-pop culture for days. HYBE America started things Wednesday with an industry party under the theme of “K-Pop’s Biggest Weekend.” The U.S. branch of the Korean-entertainment giant had a red carpet, photo booths, cotton candy machines and members of its global roster — boy bands &TEAM and Santos Bravos, as well as their pre-debut girl group SAINT SATINE — alongside Eric Nam, Ji-young Yoo and other cast members from K-Pop: The Debut , the Paramount and HYBE America film due in theaters in February 2027. title: Bad Bunny to Close Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour in Puerto Rico
summary: The two-night show will take place Aug. 22 and 23, with tickets going on sale Wednesday.
body: After a year of performances across the globe, Bad Bunny is going out with a bang — at home. Benito Antonio Martínez Ocasio is bringing the Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour to Puerto Rico to close out more than a year of performances worldwide. According to a press release issued Monday (Aug. 17), the two-night event is scheduled for Aug. 22 and 23 at Hiram Bithorn Stadium in San Juan.
